integrity: Finite projective incidence facts checked with standalone exact modular code. The arbitrary-degree theorem is proved using Bézout and blow-up intersection theory rather than extrapolation from computation.
scientific_limitations: Conditional criterion for even line arrangements; no necessity, semi-ampleness, contraction or full nef-cone classification is claimed. The characteristic-seven example is inherited from the cited paper. Independent audit is not performed.
title: A rigidity criterion for the unique Seshadri curve of an even line arrangement
